document:213.text:
Oh, the wise Helthor! The tree was his grip, and the mountain his hammerhead!
As iron and wood became one, Helthor raised his hammer high. With a mighty strike, the boulder was undone.
Lightning crackled with every strike of the hammer!

Oh, the wise Helthor! The dwarves learned from him and followed his guidance!
Thus, ignorance was shattered, and the night was lit by the light of wisdom!
document:213.source_cn:
智者赫托！他以古树为柄，又以铁石山为锤头！
铁与木交融，赫托将铁锤高举，打破坚石。
闪电于锤击中连绵！
智者赫托！矮人向他学习，矮人追随模仿！
于是……愚昧被撕碎，长夜被智慧之光照亮！

document:214.text:
All hail Helthor, mighty and grand. The volcano roared at his command, and diamonds sprang from clay and sand!
Wind and fire entwined, Helthor's flame burned bright. Melting all in its path, a force of endless might.
Everything was reborn!

 All hail Helthor, mighty and grand. Our forges are where his shrine stands.
From this day on, the fires will never fade, Helthor's name forever will be laid.
document:214.source_cn:
感谢赫托！他以火山为炉，将泥土炼成钻石！
风与火交缠，赫托之火愈发炙热，融化万物。
万物于烈焰中重铸！
 感谢赫托！矮人筑起的炉，亦是供奉他的坛。
从此……世间炉火不熄，赫托之名亦将永存。

document:215.text:
Glory to Helthor! He plunged into the abyss and brought back ores!
He cleansed the stones and removed the impurities.
His sword was sharp, his armor unyielding!

Glory to Helthor! We remember your name and honor your fame with a statue.
We see the ores as your bones, the land as your flesh.
document:215.source_cn:
赞美赫托！他潜入无边深渊，将矿石带回！
金与石分离，赫托祛除杂石，提取纯洁。
宝剑锋利铠甲坚硬！
赞美赫托！矮人牢记赫托，矮人铸成你的雕像。
矮人……将以矿石作骨，大地为体，永铸你名。
